description: Ready-to-use hooks configuration for architecture-doc-plugin. Copy to .claude/hooks.json in your project.

hooks.name: auto-update-architecture-diagram
hooks.description: Automatically regenerate architecture diagram when module structure or dependencies change.

hooks.name: auto-update-api-spec
hooks.description: Regenerate OpenAPI spec and markdown documentation when endpoint handlers are updated.

hooks.name: pre-commit-doc-freshness
hooks.description: Ensure architecture and API documentation are updated and valid before committing code.
hooks.command: python -c "import os, sys; sys.exit(0 if os.path.exists('docs/architecture.md') or os.path.exists('docs/api.md') else 1)"
